_why: tests/backend/test_panel_variant_name_codon_consistency.py decides which panel labels are accepted by asking whether a base substitution can produce a declared amino-acid change. That rests on the genetic code, a biological fact that must not be encoded from memory. Both this extract and the guard's table come from the retained NCBI file, down to the codon ordering.
name: Standard
_authority_note: This file is a READABLE EXTRACT, not the authority. The authority is the source-native tests/fixtures/ncbi_gc.prt as retrieved from NCBI on 2026-08-10, and the guard parses its codon table straight out of those bytes. A digest over this extract alone would have been circular - a transcription slip would produce a matching digest - so the pinned digest is over the source file, and every field here is asserted equal to what is parsed from it.
